Cassette Beasts is a game, while inspired by Pokemon, has many unique and creative aspects that set it apart from other monster catching games.

The gameplay mechanics and combat are the star of the show. Each element type has a strength and weakness against other types by either using moves or applying different status effects unique to the opposing element type. The fusion mechanic is intriguing as it allows for the combination of 2 monsters that result in endless possibilities. Difficultly varies from time to time but not to the point of extreme difficulty.

Its art is nicely done and vibrant. The Soundtrack is really great. Different overworld abilities make exploration engaging. The characters are nicely written. The story is interesting and keeps you engaged, but does leave a bit more to be desired.

neg.text: Cassette Beasts has a great concept, charming visuals, good music, and an interesting combat system, but the progression is frustrating and often feels like it wastes your time. The game gives you several questlines at once, but you can travel across the map only to discover that you need another traversal ability, a higher level, or a different quest completed first. The Ranger Captains are scattered everywhere, and losing can mean a long trip back because checkpoints and fast travel are not always convenient. Wild encounters also interrupt exploration constantly, while normal battles and repeated animations become repetitive. Even some quests feel like busywork, such as collecting 300 Wood early in the game just to build a sign. The game can be fun, but too much of that fun is buried under grinding, backtracking, unclear progression, and unnecessary frustration.

reviews.title: More transparency with updates
reviews.text: To preface my review, I just want to say that I honestly love this game. The style, the music, the tone, and the atmosphere are all truly refreshing. This is particularly true for a genre that seemed all but on life support before any studios decided to both challenge and reimagine the formula that Pokémon stumbled upon all those years ago. However, as someone who owns this game on both mobile and PC—and who is very tired of the Steam Link app as well as all of its requirements—I believe I can speak for the community when I say we would greatly appreciate more transparency with regard to future updates. In the same breath, I’ll also say that we want the Gauntlet/Sunshine update.

EDIT: Dropped review from 4 stars to 3 stars. I went ahead and purchased the full game to support the devs because I love the game. But now the game crashes the moment I click my save file. Fair warning for any that purchase to continue your save. Playing on iPad 9.
———
Great game, loved it on Switch and glad to see it brought to mobile. It’s a great game if you love creature catching but with a twist. You become the beasts and can even combine two together for combo abilities. It runs smoother than the Switch version, allowing for 60fps and can downgrade some effects if you are on an older device. 

It loses 1 star for some optimization issues, specifically with using controller. No options to rebind keys, no on screen prompts for what button does what, and the controller is not fully implemented. Many of the menu screens require tapping back on the screen because the B button doesn’t w

reviews.title: Good game, but the crashing
reviews.text: Bro I’m gonna actually crash out the game keeps crashing and I can’t progress at all because it keeps resetting me I just bought the full game because I loved the demo and it’s a fun game and it didn’t crash in the demo but I can’t it’s too much. I love the designs of the beasts and the story seemed decent but I can’t get anywhere because the game keeps crashing PLEASE FIX THIS! I WANNA PLAY YOUR GAME SO BADLY 🥲😭 And I payed for the whole game and I can’t get anywhere so please fix this so I can play the full game.

reviews.title: Phenomenal Game!! Just Some Slight Issues..
reviews.text: I absolutely adore this game, the style, and the overall gameplay! It’s different and definitely unique.. only issues I have with the game is that It tends to crash.. In Other instances, I find myself under the map unable to move. Despite all of this, I still played through the game in its entirety and enjoyed every bit!  Bootlegs didn’t really show up as “bootlegs” but it was still fun to look for them and to see the static in the over world

reviews.title: Just wanna play
reviews.text: The game was shaping up to be pretty good. Got to the part where the free trial ended. Sidenote if you’re gonna have specs for a game, have the full specs available during the trial phase because I believe that the specs were lowered for the trial . Decided that I wanted to pay for the game then after paying for the game, the game crashed and has done nothing but crash ever since I cannot make it past the character selection screen, or creation screen, depending on circumstances. What I have noticed is that when the game opens on most games on my iPad there’s something called game mode. I don’t know if that’s something that you guys can utilize overall would really like to play this game. It’s a five for sure if crashes stop.

reviews.title: Wish if it was free for the full game..
reviews.text: I tried the game until the game stopped when I completed the game and I wanted to see the full version just for free I think it’s in beta so idk when it’s gonna be free at the time when it has passed 1 year anniversary for the team but I liked the quality of the gameplay and the icon when it was about to release but then the gameplay ended and turned out to be a demo devs if your seeing this when y’all gonna make it free?

reviews.title: Awesome game so far!
reviews.text: I love the unique styling of this  catch and battle game! I can’t wait to see what else could be in store for it. My only issues that I’ve run into is, 1. I bought the game and it’s been verified that I have, however, the demo message still appears time to time when connection is spotty and it’ll pretty much wipe out any late game activity I’m conducting. 2. Even with an iPhone not listed on the crash warning, it still crashes time to time.

reviews.title: Great game that I paid for. However…
reviews.text: This is the end of the demo keeps popping up and stopping me. I have to restart the game multiple times to even be able to play on a new device. I have put in a lot of time, but I almost never get in the first time I try. I will consider filling out the rest of the stars when I can actually play the game. I PAID FOR THE GAME AND DLC, REMOVE THE ROADBLOCK. As much as I like the game I cannot recommend it. It halts gameplay repeatedly on even newer devices, I’ve had some crashing, there are features missing from the main game here, etc. This really needed some work before being released to the public.

reviews.title: BIG REGRET
reviews.text: After playing the demo (which I didn’t know it was after finishing the demo part. The game didn’t say anything about it being a demo) I decided to buy the full game 2 weeks later. I can’t even leave the cafe where you finding the demo at because of the crashes. I 5* this so people can see. The art, music, play style, story, and character are amazing. Wish I can see more of it thought.

reviews.title: Unacceptable amount of crashes
reviews.text: I can’t give this game 1 star because I loved the switch port so much and this game sometimes does not crash but this is still inexcusable. I admit I bought this game before seeing the amount of complaints about crashes but considering this game had a notoriously bad day 1 launch on switch, you would think this issue would have been avoided. I hope these issues can be fixed because it’s one thing if hardware limitations cause a few crashes here and there, but it’s a different story to have the game crash 4/5 times after a battle is finished!

reviews.title: Fun Game
reviews.text: Pretty fun and cool game, I like the designs of the beasts and the fusions are cool, the only thing is that I have an iPhone 13 so I keep crashing constantly, if I’m lucky I can play like 30 mins without crashing, but mostly I crash every single time I complete an encounter with a npc or a wild beast, and it’s annoying having to do the fight over again, but I like the game so I keep playing it but hopefully it doesn’t crash as much in the future

reviews.title: Great Game But Crashes
reviews.text: I love the game when I can play it, it’s so cool! But it seems like after fights the game crashes. My phone is technically not supported but I didn’t realize that until after purchasing the game, and it seems like even some users with supported devices still have game crashes. I hope that the developer will push updates for stability and it would be nice if there were maybe additional optimization settings that would allow my phone to handle the game better :(

reviews.title: Great game but
reviews.text: Just wish we could get a cross platform cloud save, or even just a save state post fights. Got the game running on iPhone 13 all the way up until I bought the full thing, I was warned so I was risking it. Bought again on Xbox but wish I could just continue where I left off. Wish I could just play on my phone, crashes wouldn’t be as painful if it meant not loosing entire fights.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work on my device.
reviews.text:
Test the game on iPod touch 6- it crashes either the app, or the entire OS in the first loading screen at like 80% I presume because the app tries to load too much data into RAM. This device only has 1GB so if you support it like the store page says, please rebuild with a system that compresses assets or something for devices with less RAM (I am assuming the issue is RAM but I honestly have no idea.)

I want to play so if this is fixed I will give a more accurate rating. So far the art is great, and the logos looked cool, so you get an extra star for those reasons.

reviews.title: Still too buggy
reviews.text: Currently the state of the game is too buggy, in that you couldn’t enter a seed for custom mode as the keyboard doesn’t show up, movement bugs, and e.t.c… (things to note before buying; game is currently 3 major updates behind the pc version of the game, multiplayer may not be implemented in the game, may crash on your device) and not a complaint but rather a preference; I would like it if we could back up more than 1 save up to the cloud, as I have many saves I would want to keep.

reviews.title: Fun but no after game options?
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the game but I was reading online and after beating the game there is supposed to be new randomization options for creating a new save and also a world seed option. I didn’t see any of these implemented in the mobile release. I was pretty disappointed that they haven’t included this in the port. Hopefully it gets added soon.

reviews.title: Control optimization
reviews.text: Big issue/bug- in the witch house in the dlc there is a switch you cannot press in the water because it just keeps trying to make you move with the floating d pad. This happens often with interact indicators but you can usually move to make it work. In this case you can’t. Make an option for a non floating d pad or just make a new button for interact. Not hard but very bad gameplay experience. Also make a change to let you just swap the minions from one friend to another without having to change friends. Game is good overall tho and will update review if fixed

reviews.title: Text too small and bad controller support
reviews.text: As the title says, the text size causes me eyestrain on my phone with no accessibility for larger text (why do modern game devs think everyone has 20/20 vision? IDK if scaling makes it look ugly, I want to actually be able to SEE) Also controller support is very half-hearted and you still have to use the touch screen constantly. The ugly on-screen controls remain there even with a controller connected. This feels like a pretty half-baked port that was an afterthought and the devs meant it for a console experience. Skip it on mobile.

reviews.title: Super Cute but still New
reviews.text: This game is adorable in style and concept and i’m really enjoying playing it and trying some of the puzzles (though they’re not my strong suit). The only problem I’ve encountered so far is crashing after some battles which is due to my phone being a slightly older model iphone, other than that this game seems great and I can’t wait to play through some more of it!!

reviews.title: Great Port!
reviews.text: This is a really good port of a great game!  Cassette Beasts bleeds style and is perfect for any fan of the monster collection genre.  One tiny thing that I hope is on the list to be fixed though is getting rid of the touch buttons when using controller.  Also, a keybind to go back in the ui would be awesome!  As it stands right now, you have to use the back button on the screen.

reviews.title: Wanted to love this game…
reviews.text: Really did want to like this game since the demo was so promising but as soon as I bought it I came to realize how buggy it is. Just now I flew down somewhere and when I landed? Game crash. There’s certain areas I’ve come to find where as soon as you enter them, it’s instant crash. If that’s the case then add some sort of auto save feature cause I just lost 1 hr worth of progress and the few beasts I recorded :) please fix this game, or lose out on its potential.

reviews.title: Good but ran into a glitch
reviews.text: It’s just like I have already played and it’s still fantastic. There is this one bug I ran into to that I wanted to bring into light which was when the camera angle changes to show things from a different angle like behind walls all avatars become just plain black shadows and it’s cause my game to crash two or three times. Just pointing it out because I love this unique creature catcher

reviews.title: I love this game, but…

But then I realized it wasn’t and I just don’t get why it must be paid for, it’s a great game don’t get me wrong but I just don’t like that you have to play after already getting into it. That is the only thing I don’t like about this game.

reviews.title: An amazing game but…
reviews.text: The mobile version does have a few issues such as bootlegs not showing the correct color, for example an ice bootleg Pombomb should have blue fur but instead has the normal black. I’ve also experienced a few crashes but not enough to really annoy me. Overall I really love this game but it is still held back by a few issues.

reviews.title: A fine mobile port.
reviews.text: I have been playing this game on console for a while now, and was excited to see that it has a mobile counterpart. It runs surprisingly smooth on my older device, and plays the same as the console. My ONLY critique is the joystick feels a bit awkward at times… Great job, and great game  Raw Fury!

reviews.title: Really cool game idea
reviews.text: Its very similar to pokemon and it has very cool unique ideas and artwork and the music is pretty good too. I almost didn’t download because of the reviews of the game crashing but on my basic iphone 15 its been working great so far only reason i put 4 star is because i just started playing and haven’t tested the crashing enough yet

reviews.title: Great Game, However
reviews.text: The game is good, and a fun way to play the original on the go, however my biggest issue and concern is that bootlegs have the sprites of the normal forms, this kind of losing the point of having them, as they do not have different colors or fun variance, another issue is the constant crashing that happens. reviews.title: Crashing
reviews.text: I love this game. I typically play on Xbox but when I found it was on mobile I rushed to download it. Out of the 4 times I battled outside of the tutorial it crashed 3 times. I recommend this game and it’s beautiful story line, art, and music but until they can fix the crashing issue it’s pretty much unplayable for me. Definitely recommend you check it out through console though!

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: Hi, I played through the first boss fight and found the game extremely enjoyable and had 0 technical issues. I thought it was so well made that I purchased the full version to show support. However upon purchasing the game it is constantly crashing and I cannot make any progress. I am very disappointed and if possible would like a refund on my 7 dollar purchase. If the issue is fixed I will be happy to come back to this review and alter it to reflect the future state of the game. Thank you.

reviews.title: A small issue for me
reviews.text: Besides the unexpected crashes. This game feels great like it is on console however I was a little disappointed by the fact the bootlegs or the camouflage status doesn’t change the color of the beast… I’m not sure if its an oversight or a bug. I hope this is fixed :)

reviews.title: Problem Solving
reviews.text: I admit I haven’t downloaded this game, but that’s because it’s on other consoles. From reviews I find a lot of people having trouble with crashing. All I suggest is buying the game on an actual console, like the Switch, Steam, and I think XBox. Cassette Beasts is a genuinely great game, but it should not be on mobile.

reviews.title: Fun! Needs some QOL
reviews.text: This is a great game and reflects the direction I didn’t know monster-catching games need to go. On mobile, it’s disruptive to start back at a campfire every time I start up, removing the progress I try to make in the minutes at a time I can play (consequentially I play less). Also, controller support needs to be more consistent in terms of what buttons to what. Looking forward to an update!

reviews.title: Fun game :)

reviews.title: So far so good

reviews.title: Great Game, Iffy Controller Support
reviews.text: Good so far but controller support seems to lack full implementation. I still need to use the touchscreen to navigate menus and touch screen buttons still appear on screen when playing. Not a deal breaker, but definitely something that could be improved!

reviews.title: Fun but buggy

Now that I’ve purchased the full game, I can’t get more than 5 mins of play time before it crashes after a battle. Luckily it autosaves so I can continue to level up but the progress in the game keeps restarting.

reviews.title: Fun game needs a major bug fix though

I tried uninstalling and redownloading but not I can’t get past the tutorial fight at the very beginning without my game crashing. Please please please fix it as I would love to play this game in it’s entirety

reviews.title: Better than Pokémon
reviews.text: I don’t like Pokémon, this game is so much better and fun in comparison. I really enjoy the story and monsters to collect. I enjoy the complex system and surprised with how much fun this game is for less than 10 dollars, games now cost $70 so this is really well worth it.

reviews.title: Played on Steam - Loved It
reviews.text: Fantastic creature collector. Theres enough beasts that its a challenge to collect them all but it feels actually acheiveable compared to other, similar game types. The type interactions elevate the gameplay, I only wish they happened earlier in the story. Solid game all around.

reviews.title: Good game, but the mobile port has lag issues
reviews.text: The game is good but a few things bother me, the colors are slightly brighter which bothers me as someone who played before. The game could use more setting to reduce lag as i could notice it getting a little bad at some points. And finally during the tutorial the game crashed after recording Dominoth, please fix this.

reviews.title: Crashes After Buying Game
reviews.text: I enjoyed the free trial and beat it within minutes of starting the game. I bought the game then it started freezing every few minutes and closing itself. I uninstalled and reinstalled the game then it deleted all my data. I restarted and got all the way to the same spot where you fight the “zombies”. Every time I get here is when the issues begin. I would like my money back for a game that does not work.

reviews.title: Constant Crashes
reviews.text: I have wanted to love this game for a while now, but I get a crash every time I finish a battle with anything besides a wild beast. I paid money for this game because I had heard how good this was on PC and figured mobile would be a similar experience that I could take on the go. The lack of polish and constant crashes for a paid product are frankly unacceptable. Please fix the crashes, when you do I’ll change my rating.

reviews.title: Good but…

reviews.title: Very fun, but crashes after I win battles

reviews.title: Nice!
